scenes.dialogue: A man dies abroad, and his relatives cannot agree where to bury him. His body waits in a forensic lab for a year and a half. Who must step in?
It happened to a seventy one year old Indian in the U A E. Even this October, his body was still in that forensic lab. So what can a court do?
